{{Quote|Senator Sauro has succeeded in utilizing a little-known procedural item called a sitting Senator's right of refusal. This has allowed him to block the order to reveal for an indefinite period.|Mas Amedda|<ref name="Jedi Quest: The School of Fear">''[[Jedi Quest: The School of Fear]]''</ref>}}
A '''sitting Senator's right of refusal''' was a procedural rule of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] that was used in [[326 BBY]] and then effectively forgotten for three [[Time/Legends|centuries]] until used again by [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Sano Sauro]] in [[26 BBY/Legends|26 BBY]].
